If not, repeat the last comfortable stage and shift later sessions manually. Belt speeds are conditional targets, not mandatory minimums. Easy effort must allow full sentences; lower speed if needed without extending time.
helpers: Treadmill at 0% incline; running shoes, water and towel.
Use the safety clip. Change belt speed while staying on the belt; allow smooth acceleration and deceleration within each timed step.
